project.name: Destiny OS :: Engine :: Western Astrology
project.description:
Western (tropical) astrology chart angles - research items R5/R6, Phase 11.
Ships the part of a natal chart that is pure spherical astronomy and already golden-tested infrastructure: the Sun's tropical position (reused from destiny-calendar's SolarPosition), Midheaven, Ascendant, and the twelve Whole Sign houses derived from it.
Does NOT ship the other nine planets (Moon through Pluto) or aspects. Both need data or a decision this phase does not yet have: planetary positions need VSOP87/ELP2000 coefficient tables sourced and cross-checked with the same rigor as SolarPosition, which has not been done; aspects need an orb policy (R6) that is still open. Both are reported as explicitly blocked sections rather than silently omitted (ADR D7), the same pattern destiny-engine-bazi uses for Dung Than and Day Master strength.
Zodiac: Tropical (owner decision, 2026-08-23, RESEARCH_BLOCKERS.md R6). House system: Whole Sign for this first version - correct at every latitude including the polar circle, where Placidus and Koch are mathematically undefined (owner decision, same date).
Framework-free, like the other engines. Depends on destiny-calendar for Julian date conversion and the Sun's ecliptic longitude.
